_comment: Queue for the Backlog Advancer. type 'regen' runs `npm run <script>` in a worktree; type 'claude' runs a scoped headless claude prompt (gated by enableClaudeTasks). A claude task gets Read/Glob/Grep/Edit/Write only — declare `allowedTools` to widen it. status: pending | in-review | done.

tasks.title: Inventory generator output paths and write modes
tasks.prompt:
Build an inventory of what the repo's generators write. Scope it to at most 25 scripts: run `ls scripts/generate-*.mjs`, and if there are more than 25, take the first 25 alphabetically and say so in the report.

This is an inventory pass, not a deep analysis. For each script, skim it for its write calls (writeFile, writeFileSync, outputFile, cp, rename) and record:
  - Script name
  - Output path(s) it writes, as literals where the code gives literals; if a path is built at runtime, record the expression rather than guessing the result
  - Write mode: WHOLE-FILE if it serializes a freshly built string over the whole file, MERGE if it reads the existing file and edits regions or fields, UNCLEAR if the code does not plainly say
  - The file:line of the write call

Do not attempt cross-generator collision analysis and do not rank risk; a later pass does that. Accuracy and coverage of these four columns is the whole job.

Write the inventory to night-shift/audits/generator-write-inventory.md as a markdown table with those columns, sorted by script name, preceded by one line stating how many scripts exist and how many this pass covered. Record only what the code shows; mark anything you could not determine as UNCLEAR rather than inferring it.

Write exactly one file: night-shift/audits/generator-write-inventory.md. Change no other file.

tasks.title: Inventory generator output paths and write modes (part 2)
tasks.prompt:
Continue the generator write inventory. Part 1 covered the first 25 of the scripts matching `ls scripts/generate-*.mjs`; this pass covers the REMAINDER (26th onward). Read night-shift/audits/generator-write-inventory.md first to match its table columns, mode legend, and conventions exactly, so the two files can be concatenated.

For each script in scope record: script name; output path(s), as literals where the code gives literals and as the expression where a path is built at runtime; write mode (WHOLE-FILE / MERGE / UNCLEAR per part 1's legend); and the file:line of the write call.

No collision analysis and no risk ranking — a later pass does that. Record only what the code shows; mark anything undetermined as UNCLEAR rather than inferring it.

Write exactly one file: night-shift/audits/generator-write-inventory-part2.md. Change no other file.

tasks.title: Find output paths written by more than one generator
tasks.prompt:
Read every inventory file present under night-shift/audits/ (generator-write-inventory*.md) and find output paths that MORE THAN ONE generator writes. State up front which inventory files you found and what fraction of the generators they cover — if part 2 is missing, say the analysis is partial rather than implying it is complete.

For each collision report: the shared output path; every generator that writes it; each one's write mode; and the resulting hazard, stated concretely. A WHOLE-FILE write to a path another generator also contributes to is the case that silently destroys content — call those out first. Two MERGE writers are usually fine; say so rather than padding the list.

Verify each collision against the actual source before reporting it; the inventories are a lead, not proof. Cite file:line from the generators themselves. If a collision turns out to be spurious on inspection, leave it out.

Write exactly one file: night-shift/audits/generator-write-collisions.md. Change no other file.
